KnowledgeArticle.Title: Neighbor Odor
KnowledgeArticle.Description: The City does not accept complaints about body or cooking odor from a residence.

Section.Name: Neighbor Odor
Section.Content:
Need something else?

  • Restaurant Odor to report a smell coming from a restaurant
  • Indoor Air Quality for complaints about other odors
  • Mediation for help speaking directly to a neighbor about odor

The City does not accept complaints about poor air quality in a residence caused by a neighbor's body odor or cooking.

Section.Name: Commercial and Residential Barbecuing
Section.Content: For information about barbecuing rules on commercial and residential property, refer to the Barbecuing page.
